WITH age_answers AS (
  SELECT a.UserID, a.SurveyID, CAST(a.AnswerText AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM Answer a
  JOIN Question q ON a.QuestionID = q.questionid
  WHERE q.questiontext = 'What is your age?'
), gender_answers AS (
  SELECT a.UserID, a.SurveyID, a.AnswerText AS gender
  FROM Answer a
  JOIN Question q ON a.QuestionID = q.questionid
  WHERE q.questiontext = 'What is your gender?'
), burden_answers AS (
  SELECT a.UserID, a.SurveyID,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.AnswerText)) = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS yes_flag
  FROM Answer a
  JOIN Question q ON a.QuestionID = q.questionid
  WHERE LOWER(q.questiontext) LIKE '%mental health%interfere%'
     OR LOWER(q.questiontext) LIKE '%seek treatment for a mental health condition%'
     OR LOWER(q.questiontext) LIKE '%currently have a mental health disorder%'
     OR LOWER(q.questiontext) LIKE '%diagnosed with a mental health condition%'
), respondent_groups AS (
  SELECT g.gender,
         CASE
           WHEN ag.age BETWEEN 18 AND 34 THEN '18-34'
           WHEN ag.age BETWEEN 35 AND 49 THEN '35-49'
           WHEN ag.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 THEN '50-65'
         END AS age_group,
         b.yes_flag
  FROM age_answers ag
  JOIN gender_answers g ON g.UserID = ag.UserID AND g.SurveyID = ag.SurveyID
  JOIN burden_answers b ON b.UserID = ag.UserID AND b.SurveyID = ag.SurveyID
  WHERE g.gender IN ('Male','Female')
    AND ag.age BETWEEN 18 AND 65
), burden_rates AS (
  SELECT gender, age_group, AVG(yes_flag * 1.0) AS burden_rate
  FROM respondent_groups
  WHERE age_group IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY gender, age_group
)
SELECT gender, age_group, burden_rate
FROM burden_rates
